screen.title: Fitness Class Sign-Up
text: Spring yoga and dance classes are free for students. Sign up at the front desk with your student ID. Each class has 20 places. If a class is full, add your name to the waiting list.

questions.stem: How can students join a class?
options: By paying for it at the desk
By signing up at the front desk
By sending an email to the sports center

why.en: Detail: "Sign up at the front desk with your student ID". A contradicts "free for students".
why.tr: Ayrıntı: "Sign up at the front desk with your student ID". A "free for students" bilgisiyle çelişiyor.
why.es: Detalle: "Sign up at the front desk with your student ID". A contradice "free for students".

questions.stem: What should a student do if a class is full?
options: Put their name on the waiting list
Come back when the next term starts
Join a dance class at the same time
Ask the desk staff for a bigger room

why.en: Detail: "add your name to the waiting list". C is not suggested anywhere on the sign.
why.tr: Ayrıntı: "add your name to the waiting list". C tabelada hiçbir yerde önerilmiyor.
why.es: Detalle: "add your name to the waiting list". C no se sugiere en ningún lugar del cartel.
